ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-L in
the area bound by:

a line 107.25 feet south of and parallel to West 64" Street; the alley next east of parallel
to South Central Avenue; a line 159.25 feet south of and parallel to West 64" Street; and
South Central Avenue,

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Um

Marty QhinrJ T
Alderman, 13 Ward

6411 S. Central Avenue
